title: Extension property for coefficient-lifted etale sheaves
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] in universe u and I an injective abelian sheaf [def-sp-injective-resolutions] with coefficients in AddCommGrpCat.{u}. Let f : A → B be a monomorphism of abelian sheaves with coefficients in AddCommGrpCat.{u+1}, with B(U) u-small for every object U of X.Etale. Every map g : A → ULift(I) extends to B: there exists h : B → ULift(I) with f ≫ h = g.

source.place: Injectives, Lemma 19.7.3: extension criterion across subsheaves of free representables.

proof.text: Transport the abelian group structure on Shrink G via equivShrink for every u-small group G. AddEquiv.ulift followed by the transported equivalence gives an isomorphism from a lifted u-small abelian group to G. Apply this pointwise and Mathlib Functor.essImage.liftFunctor to descend a small-valued presheaf; its lift is naturally isomorphic to the original presheaf. A fully faithful functor reflects limits, so the sheaf condition descends too.

A is objectwise u-small because f is objectwise injective and B is u-small. Descend A and B by the preceding construction, conjugate f and g by the lift isomorphisms, and take preimages under the fully faithful sheafCompose. The descended f is mono by faithfulness. Apply Injective.factors to the descended g and f; map the extension by sheafCompose and conjugate back. The factorization identity follows by faithfulness and functoriality.

mathlib_searches.query: Injective objects in abelian sheaves criterion extension from small sheaves
Universe lift of an injective abelian sheaf on a small site is injective
mathlib_searches.results: No direct sheaf result; ModuleCat.ulift_injective_of_injective concerns individual modules.
No sheaf injectivity criterion. Generic Injective.factors, ULift full faithfulness, essential-image lifting, and reflection of limits supply the descent proof.

from.place: Extension step in the proof of coefficient-lift injectivity.
